name: v0.17.3
body:
## Highlights

### WebAssembly components by default

New modules now default to native WebAssembly components. Extism modules remain supported with `--runtime extism`, and existing modules retain automatic runtime detection. Publishing accepts both core Wasm modules and components, with structural validation and the existing 64 MiB limit.

### Faster, more reliable module transfers

- Upload and download progress indicators for publishing and dependency installation.
- Parallel dependency resolution and downloads with bounded concurrency, verified artifact caching, and guard-file cleanup.
- Compressed publish uploads and retries for transient network failures, with fresh authentication for each attempt.
- Safe retries after an interrupted upload: identical artifacts can be recovered without overwriting an existing release.

### Smarter publishing and simpler module references

Publishing reuses descriptive metadata from the authenticated author's previous PDS release, including description, license, topics, supported platforms, repository, README, and logo. CLI flags and local metadata take precedence. Missing required fields still prompt; release versions and artifacts are never inherited.

Registry handles can omit the leading `@`, including when displaying module help:

```sh
fluentci run --wasm fluentci.io/setup-gh --help
fluentci run fluentci.io/setup-node setup --version 24.22.2
```

Official modules also support their short name. Invalid GitHub-style publisher scopes now receive a clearer explanation.

## Registry and API reliability

- Live Jetstream ingestion runs independently of historical replay, so backfills no longer delay new publications and metadata updates.
- Bounded replay queues, reconnect recovery, watchdogs, and PDS reconciliation improve indexing resilience.
- Migrated to the official Drizzle Node SQLite driver while preserving database settings, transaction ordering, and migration history.
- Added upload deadlines and phase diagnostics for troubleshooting slow publishes.

## Landing and module pages

- Sticky README/Docs navigation and profile filters.
- Compact publisher identity stays visible while scrolling profile pages.
- More colorful syntax highlighting in dark and light themes.
- Installation script available at `/install.sh`.

## CI and desktop releases

- Repository CI modules use typed PureScript WebAssembly components and named arguments.
- Toolchains are provisioned through FluentCI registry plugins, with verified artifact bootstrapping for older CLI releases.
- `setup-rust@0.2.1` installs the requested toolchain, components, and compilation targets.
- `setup-determinate-nix@0.2.1` configures runner trust for Cachix during installation.
- Improved rustfmt diagnostics, Linux package tests, and macOS desktop packaging disk cleanup and DMG capacity handling.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/fluentci-io/fluentci/compare/v0.17.2...v0.17.3
